name: styles
description: Nine tool-independent editing styles for real footage, one skill each: talk_ahead (talking-head explainer, every fact becomes a visual), pod_glow (podcast / interview clips), brand_stage (presenter speaking for a brand, studio or agency), case_reel (case-study ad story template), spotlight_word (talking-head intros and stories, one word at a time with yellow spotlight words), in_scene_type (single presenter, layered type inside the shot, no cut-aways), holo_scene (presenter in a real place, cyan holograms and a CGI dive), editorial_showcase (editorial explanation with type and document scenes, lower-screen demos and three-row portfolio showcases), ui_cascade (letter-by-letter caption stacks with one glowing accent word, 3D icon tiles, glass card fans, full-screen app scenes and negative-flash cuts).
